moments.title: Latitude Festival wraps up
moments.blurb: The Klarna presents Latitude Festival concludes today at Henham Park in Suffolk, after a weekend of music, comedy, and arts.

angles.name: Festival Farewell
angles.copy: Packing up the tent and the memories! Latitude Festival closes its gates tonight after a fantastic weekend in Suffolk. What was your highlight?

angles.name: Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: From Henham Park to your speakers – Latitude Festival delivered another incredible lineup. Who did you catch this weekend?

moments.title: Truck Festival concludes
moments.blurb: Truck Festival, Oxfordshire's indie music event, finishes its run today at Hill Farm, Steventon.

angles.name: Indie Send-off
angles.copy: The fields of Oxfordshire are quieting down as Truck Festival wraps up. Big shout-out to everyone who made it a brilliant weekend!

angles.name: Post-Festival Glow
angles.copy: Still buzzing from Truck Festival? What was the stand-out set for you this year?

moments.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
moments.blurb: The legendary frontman of The Rolling Stones, Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday tomorrow, July 26.

angles.name: Still Rolling
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the one and only Mick Jagger hits 83! Still got those moves like Jagger. What's your favourite Stones track?

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: 83 years young for Sir Mick Jagger tomorrow! An absolute rock legend. What's the most iconic Mick Jagger moment for you?

angles.name: Drum Legend
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we're celebrating the one and only Roger Taylor from Queen as he turns 77! Give it up for one of rock's greatest drummers!

angles.name: Queen's Beat
angles.copy: From 'Bohemian Rhapsody' to 'Radio Ga Ga', Roger Taylor's drumming is unmistakable. Happy 77th for tomorrow! What's your favourite Queen song?

angles.name: Free & Bad Company

angles.copy: The voice and bass of Rush, Geddy Lee, turns 73 this Tuesday! His influence on rock music is immense. What's your favourite Rush album?

angles.name: Running Up That Hill
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible artistry of Kate Bush, who turns 68 on Wednesday. Her music continues to inspire generations. Tell us your go-to track!
